title: Waiting at the GATE Turns You Green 🌿
description:
Never wait for someone at the front gate. Moss grows on you while you wait. The man at the bus stop is mostly hedge by now. I've never had a speck, because I've never waited for anybody.

My wife, Maggie, and I have kept our caravan on the headland for thirty years. This autumn she's coming up green, and it won't come off when I get back.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment GREEN if someone always keeps you waiting.
